Add pediatric growth-chart and blood-pressure reference values

Source: R/pediatric-references.R
add_pediatric_references.Rd

Derives the reference inputs that score_le8() needs for pediatric BMI and blood-pressure scoring from raw measurements:

  • bmi_percentile and bmi_percent_of_p95 (ages 2 to 19): CDC 2000 BMI-for-age percentile, using the CDC extended BMI method above the 95th percentile, and BMI as a percentage of the 95th percentile, from cdcanthro::cdc_z().

  • infant_weight_z and infant_weight_percentile (under age 2): WHO weight-for-length (or BMI-for-age) z-score and percentile, from cdcanthro::who_z().

  • systolic_bp_p90, systolic_bp_p95, diastolic_bp_p90, and diastolic_bp_p95 (ages 1 to 12): the AAP 2017 (Flynn et al.) 90th and 95th blood-pressure percentiles for the child's age, sex, and height, from pedbp::q_bp().

Requires the suggested packages cdcanthro (for growth charts) and pedbp (for blood pressure); each is needed only when data contains rows of the corresponding ages. Values are left missing outside the stated ages and wherever a required measurement is missing. In particular, the blood-pressure references are not computed without height: pedbp would otherwise assume a median-height child.

infant_weight_z_change, the change in the infant z-score since the prior routine visit, needs longitudinal data and is not derived here. Compute it from infant_weight_z within each child; see vignette("pediatric-scoring").

Usage

add_pediatric_references(
  data,
  sex = "sex",
  height = "height_cm",
  weight = "weight_kg",
  bmi = NULL,
  age_months = NULL,
  completed_months = FALSE,
  infant_measure = c("weight_for_length", "bmi_for_age"),
  bp_source = "flynn2017"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame. Rows aged 20 or older are returned unchanged.

sex

Name of the sex column: "m"/"f", "male"/"female", or 0/1 (0 = male), or a logical column named female.

height

Name of the column holding height in cm (recumbent length before age 2).

weight

Name of the column holding weight in kg.

bmi

Optional name of a BMI column in kg/m^2. When NULL (the default), BMI is calculated from weight and height.

age_months

Optional name of a column holding age in months. When NULL, age_months is used if present, otherwise age * 12.

completed_months

If FALSE (the default), ages are exact, so 54 months means exactly 4.5 years. If TRUE, ages are completed months (as in NHANES) and 0.5 is added before every reference lookup. Unlike calling cdcanthro directly, whose midpoint adjustment depends on whether every age in the batch is a whole number, the result for one row never depends on the other rows.

infant_measure

Under age 2, "weight_for_length" (the default, the more common clinical measure) or "bmi_for_age"; AHA 2022 accepts either.

bp_source

The pedbp blood-pressure reference. The default, "flynn2017", is the AAP 2017 guideline that LE8 cites.

Value

data, with the eight reference columns described above appended. It is an error for data to contain any of them already.

References

Lloyd-Jones DM, Allen NB, Anderson CAM, et al. (2022). Life's Essential 8. Circulation, 146(5), e18-e43. doi:10.1161/CIR.0000000000001078

Flynn JT, Kaelber DC, Baker-Smith CM, et al. (2017). Clinical Practice Guideline for Screening and Management of High Blood Pressure in Children and Adolescents. Pediatrics, 140(3), e20171904. doi:10.1542/peds.2017-1904

Wei R, Ogden CL, Parsons VL, Freedman DS, Hales CM (2020). A method for calculating BMI z-scores and percentiles above the 95th percentile of the CDC growth charts. Annals of Human Biology, 47(6), 514-521. doi:10.1080/03014460.2020.1808065

See also

score_le8()

Examples

children <- data.frame(
  id = c("a", "b"),
  age = c(5.5, 14),
  sex = c("female", "male"),
  height_cm = c(112, 165),
  weight_kg = c(19, 70)
)
add_pediatric_references(children)
#>   id  age    sex height_cm weight_kg bmi_percentile bmi_percent_of_p95
#> 1  a  5.5 female       112        19       49.65858           81.93710
#> 2  b 14.0   male       165        70       94.53158           98.84544
#>   infant_weight_z infant_weight_percentile systolic_bp_p90 systolic_bp_p95
#> 1              NA                       NA        106.7036        110.5857
#> 2              NA                       NA              NA              NA
#>   diastolic_bp_p90 diastolic_bp_p95
#> 1         67.15812         70.60702
#> 2               NA               NA
